# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Implemented the two pending helper-layer remediations by extracting a single canonical `pub(crate)` `concentration_from_total()` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`, re-exporting it for internal crate use, removing the duplicated local copy from `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs`, and standardizing `crates/tank_core/src/systems/algae_growth.rs` on `TankState::concentrations()` so algae growth reuses one canonical net-water-volume lookup through `ConcentrationView`.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected the current `water`, `nitrogen_cycle`, and `algae_growth` implementations to confirm the duplicated concentration helper and the inconsistent concentration-access pattern.
1. [Completed] Extracted the canonical shared `concentration_from_total()` helper into `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`, updated `WaterState` helper methods to use it, re-exported it through `types/mod.rs`, and removed the duplicate local implementation from `nitrogen_cycle.rs`.
2. [Completed] Standardized `algae_growth.rs` on `TankState::concentrations()` so the system uses the cached `ConcentrationView` path and computes net water volume once before reading TAN, nitrate, and phosphate concentrations.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting, a full workspace test pass, and `rg` sanity checks to verify there is now only one `concentration_from_total()` definition and that algae growth uses the canonical concentration-view path.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` completed successfully.
- `cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
- `rg -n "fn concentration_from_total" crates/tank_core/src -g'*.rs'` now reports a single definition in `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`.
- `rg -n "concentrations\(\)" crates/tank_core/src/systems/algae_growth.rs crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs` confirms `algae_growth.rs` now uses `TankState::concentrations()` and `nitrogen_cycle.rs` imports the shared helper.
- No `.beads/` files changed in this remediation pass, so `br lint` was not required.

## Outstanding Risks

- `TankState` convenience helpers still each call `self.concentrations()` independently, so non-hot-path callers that invoke several helpers in sequence can still recompute net water volume unless they reuse `ConcentrationView` directly.
- Legacy process field names such as `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total` and `aob_k_tan_mg` still read like total-mass parameters even though runtime semantics are now concentration- or area-normalized; that rename work remains deferred to downstream normalization beads.
- Schema-2 save migration still assumes legacy dissolved totals were authored against gross water volume, so a hand-edited or previously pre-migrated schema-2 file could still be rescaled again on load.
